errors.evidence: The chart displays data for 21 countries, not 20.

errors.text_span: in alphabetischer Reihenfolge von oben nach unten auf
errors.evidence: The countries on the y-axis are not listed in alphabetical order. The order is primarily descending based on the total bar length (Polen, Estland, Lettland, Litauen, etc.).
The total bar for Poland ends visibly below the 4% mark, at approximately 3.8% or 3.9%.

errors.text_span: wobei der blaue Anteil (Anstieg) etwa 2,1 % und der grüne Anteil (2021) etwa 2,0 % beträgt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns the values to the colored segments for Poland. The light green bar (2021) is approximately 2.1%, and the blue bar (increase) is smaller, at about 1.7%.

errors.text_span: Estland folgt mit einem Gesamtwert von etwa 3,5 %
errors.evidence: The total bar for Estonia reaches approximately 3.2% of GDP, not 3.5%.

errors.text_span: wobei der blaue Anteil etwa 1,9 % und der grüne Anteil etwa 1,6 % beträgt
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns values to the colored segments for Estonia. The light green bar is the larger component at ~2.3%, while the blue bar is much smaller at ~0.9%.
The total bar for Slowenien has a value of approximately 1.4%, not 1.1%. Additionally, it is not one of the three countries with the lowest values; Luxemburg, Belgien, and Spanien are all lower.

errors.text_span: In allen Fällen ist der blaue Anteil kleiner als der grüne Anteil
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. For Rumänien (Romania), the blue bar (increase) is visibly larger than the light green bar (2021 spending).

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern alphabetisch angeordnet
errors.evidence: This is incorrect and contradicts an earlier error. The bars are neither unsorted nor alphabetically arranged. They are sorted, mostly in descending order of their total length.
